description: This file defines the API and data structures for implementing connection manager connectivity layers in Zephyr OS, including binding network interfaces to connectivity implementations, setting options, and managing connection states.

methods.name: conn_mgr_if_get_binding
methods.description: Retrieves the binding structure for a given network interface if it exists.

methods.name: conn_mgr_binding_lock
methods.description: Locks the binding mutex to ensure thread-safe access.

methods.name: conn_mgr_binding_unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the binding mutex after access.

methods.name: conn_mgr_binding_set_flag
methods.description: Sets a specific connectivity flag for the binding.

methods.name: conn_mgr_binding_get_flag
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific connectivity flag for the binding.
